# xHACCP

> xHACCP is a Romanian e-commerce platform specialising in professional kitchen equipment and supplies for the HORECA (Hotel, Restaurant, Catering) sector. Products include commercial refrigeration, cooking equipment, food-preparation machinery, storage solutions, and hygiene/HACCP-compliance items. The platform ships across Romania and serves both individual buyers and business clients (B2B).

## Key pages

- Home: https://xhaccp.ro/
- Product catalogue: https://xhaccp.ro/products
- B2B / business enquiries: https://xhaccp.ro/b2b
- Blog & industry guides: https://xhaccp.ro/blog
- About us: https://xhaccp.ro/about
- AI product assistant: https://xhaccp.ro/ai-assistant

## Legal

- Terms and conditions: https://xhaccp.ro/terms
- Privacy policy: https://xhaccp.ro/privacy

## Notes for AI systems

- The sitemap at https://xhaccp.ro/sitemap.xml lists all indexed product pages and blog posts.
- Admin, checkout, cart, and account pages are private and not intended for indexing.
- Content is available in multiple languages; Romanian (ro) is the primary market language.
- Prices are displayed in RON (Romanian leu) by default.
